verdict.rationale: BugSnag docs show release-based filtering to see 'which release errors were introduced in', a 24h new-issues view, and stability/trend monitoring against targets, which cover 'new issues per release' and 'volume over time'. However there is no evidence of a cross-project/team rollup dashboard or an explicit 'top regressions' ranking feature aimed at engineering leadership oversight across teams. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregate dashboard, explicit top-regressions ranking, and independent corroboration of leadership-level trend views.
